scope: Primary second-pass visual review of partial source-assisted weak labels. Every canonical source was viewed. Selected structural cap components, wall/rail/glass crops and background region placement were checked; ambiguous exterior cap sections and background/fence overlap were removed. Not exhaustive, independently human-annotated ground truth. No model prediction supplied any positive or negative training label.
limitations: Artist cutaway caps are weak source supervision, not an exact wall-surface outline.
Unknown pixels are 255. Missing labels are not evidence of background.
Glass training covers one new layout; validation glass covers one different layout.
Partial fence and window material patches do not define complete barrier geometry.
Whole-layout validation/test splits were frozen before these trials; no derivative crosses a split.
Possible warm/cool emitters are conservatively excluded from background; new light positives are not claimed.
